senses.title: Analysis of non-numerical material
senses.definition: the examination of words, images, documents or observed actions rather than numerical measurements
senses.definitionCN: 考察词语、图像、文件或观察到的行为，而非数值测量
senses.example: Qualitative analysis looks for meaning and pattern rather than for a coefficient.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析寻找的是意义与模式，而不是系数。
senses.why: Some questions are about what an experience means, and meaning does not arrive as a number.
senses.whyCN: 有些问题问的是经验意味着什么，而意义并不以数字的形式到来。

senses.title: Thematic analysis
senses.definition: the identification and organisation of recurring themes across a body of material
senses.definitionCN: 在一批材料中识别并组织反复出现的主题
senses.example: Thematic qualitative analysis produced three themes about trust and one about time.
senses.exampleCN: 主题式定性分析产生了三个关于信任的主题，以及一个关于时间的主题。
senses.why: A theme is a pattern that recurs across cases, and the analyst must show the cases behind it.
senses.whyCN: 主题是跨个案反复出现的模式，分析者必须展示支撑它的个案。

senses.title: Content analysis
senses.definition: the systematic classification and counting of visible features such as words, frames or images
senses.definitionCN: 对词语、框架或图像等可见特征进行系统分类与计数
senses.example: Content analysis can sit inside qualitative analysis when categories are counted but meaning is also read.
senses.exampleCN: 当类别被计数、意义也被解读时，内容分析可以归在定性分析之内。
senses.why: Counting does not make a study quantitative if the categories themselves were built by reading for meaning.
senses.whyCN: 如果类别本身是通过解读意义建立的，计数并不会让研究变成定量。

senses.title: Coding and grounded theory
senses.definition: the line-by-line labelling of material and the building of categories from the data upward
senses.definitionCN: 逐行标注材料，并从数据向上建立类别
senses.example: Grounded-theory coding is a common route through qualitative analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 扎根理论编码是定性分析中常见的一条路径。
senses.why: The claim is that categories should grow from the material rather than be imposed before reading.
senses.whyCN: 其主张是类别应从材料中生长出来，而不是在阅读前被强加。

senses.title: Case study analysis
senses.definition: the detailed examination of one case or a small set of cases, often combining several kinds of evidence
senses.definitionCN: 对一个或少数个案进行细致考察，常结合多种证据
senses.example: Case study analysis within qualitative analysis traced how a policy changed practice.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析中的个案研究分析追踪了一项政策如何改变实践。
senses.why: A single case cannot be averaged, so the analysis must show mechanism rather than frequency.
senses.whyCN: 单个个案无法被平均，因此分析必须展示机制而不是频率。

senses.title: The contrast with quantitative analysis
senses.definition: the difference between asking how much and asking what kind, how and why
senses.definitionCN: 追问「多少」与追问「何种、如何、为何」之间的区别
senses.example: Qualitative analysis asks what the pattern means, while quantitative analysis asks how large it is.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析追问模式意味着什么，定量分析追问它有多大。
senses.why: The two approaches answer different questions, and a mixed design uses both rather than choosing a winner.
senses.whyCN: 两种取径回答不同问题，混合设计同时使用两者，而不是选一个赢家。

senses.title: Trustworthiness and reflexivity
senses.definition: the criteria of credibility, transferability, dependability and confirmability, supported by an audit trail
senses.definitionCN: 可信性、可迁移性、可靠性与可确认性等标准，并由审计轨迹支撑
senses.example: Trustworthiness in qualitative analysis is established through an audit trail and peer checking.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析中的可信度通过审计轨迹与同伴核查来建立。
senses.why: When the usual statistical criteria do not apply, the work must show its reasoning in public instead.
senses.whyCN: 当通常的统计标准不适用时，研究必须改为公开展示自己的推理。

senses.title: Software-assisted coding
senses.definition: the use of programs to store, label, retrieve and compare coded segments without replacing the analyst's reading
senses.definitionCN: 用程序存储、标注、检索与比较已编码片段，但不取代分析者的阅读
senses.example: Software made the qualitative analysis traceable across four hundred pages of transcripts.
senses.exampleCN: 软件使这项定性分析在四百页逐字稿中仍可追溯。
senses.why: A program can hold the labels and find them again, but it cannot decide what a passage means.
senses.whyCN: 程序可以保存标签并再次找到它们，却不能决定一段文字意味着什么。

intro.en: Qualitative analysis joins qualitative, from Latin qualis, of what kind, to analysis, from Greek analusis, a loosening.
intro.cn: 这个术语把来自拉丁语 qualis「何种性质」的 qualitative，与来自希腊语 analusis「拆解」的 analysis 组合起来。

items.en: Qualis was a question word meaning of what kind, and it supplied the base of quality.
items.cn: qualis 是表示「何种性质」的疑问词，提供 quality 的词基。

items.en: Qualitas named the nature or character of a thing, a translation coinage for a Greek term.
items.cn: qualitas 指事物的本性或特征，是为对应希腊术语而造的译词。

items.en: English used quality for a characteristic and later for excellence; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语用 quality 指特征，后来指优良程度；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The adjective qualitative marked what concerns kind rather than amount; it spread in nineteenth-century science.
items.cn: 形容词 qualitative 标出关乎种类而非数量，在十九世纪科学中传播。

items.en: Analusis meant a loosening or resolving, from ana- up and luein to loosen.
items.cn: analusis 意为松开或拆解，由 ana-「向上」与 luein「松开」构成。

items.en: Social research joined the two words for the analysis of meaning-bearing material; the phrase is twentieth-century.
items.cn: 社会科学把这两个词组合成对承载意义之材料的分析；这个短语属二十世纪。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like qualitative analysis; the second group names neighbouring approaches to meaning-bearing material.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 qualitative analysis 相近；第二组是与「处理意义材料」意思相邻的取径。

entries.definition: A characteristic, or the degree of excellence.
entries.definitionCN: 指特征，或优良程度。

entries.definition: Concerned with kind or meaning rather than amount.
entries.definitionCN: 指关乎种类或意义而非数量。

entries.definition: The separation of a whole into parts for examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指把整体拆成部分加以考察。

entries.definition: To carry out such an examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指进行这样的考察。

entries.definition: Concerned with amount and measurement; it looks close but its base is quantity.
entries.definitionCN: 指关乎数量与测量；形近但词基是数量。

entries.definition: A method for identifying and organising recurring themes.
entries.definitionCN: 指识别并组织反复主题的方法。

entries.definition: Systematic classification and counting of visible features.
entries.definitionCN: 指对可见特征进行系统分类与计数。

entries.definition: An approach that builds categories upward from the data.
entries.definitionCN: 指从数据向上建立类别的取径。

entries.definition: Long-term study of a group through immersion and field notes.
entries.definitionCN: 指通过长期沉浸与田野笔记研究一个群体。

entries.definition: Detailed examination of one case or a few cases.
entries.definitionCN: 指对一个或少数个案的细致考察。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations work through the real parts, word family and common phrases behind this term.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想依托这个术语背后真实的构词部件、同族词与常见搭配。

normal.en: Qualis asks of what kind, and analysis loosens a whole into parts, so the phrase means taking meaning-bearing material apart by kind.
normal.cn: qualis 问「何种性质」，「分析」把整体拆成部分，这个短语指按性质拆开承载意义的材料。

normal.en: A theme is a pattern with cases behind it, not a label invented at the end.
normal.cn: 主题是有个案支撑的模式，而不是最后发明出来的标签。

normal.en: Coding is writing on the margin until the margin becomes a map.
normal.cn: 编码是在页边写字，直到页边变成一张地图。

normal.en: Trustworthiness replaces the statistical checklist with an audit trail and peer checking.
normal.cn: 可信度用审计轨迹与同伴核查取代统计清单。

normal.en: Software stores labels and finds them, but it cannot read for meaning.
normal.cn: 软件保存并查找标签，却不能解读意义。

abstract.en: A number answers how much, while a meaning answers what it was like, and the second question cannot be averaged.
abstract.cn: 数字回答多少，意义回答那是什么感觉，而第二个问题无法被平均。

abstract.en: The analyst is a reader with a history, and the audit trail is the history made visible.
abstract.cn: 分析者是带着历史的读者，审计轨迹就是被变得可见的历史。

abstract.en: A theme is a room that many quotations enter, and the analyst must show the door.
abstract.cn: 主题是许多引语进入的房间，分析者必须指出那扇门。

examples.en: Qualitative analysis of the interviews identified three themes about trust.
examples.cn: 对访谈的定性分析识别出三个关于信任的主题。

examples.en: The paper explains how qualitative analysis was coded and checked by a second reader.
examples.cn: 论文说明了定性分析如何编码并由第二位读者核查。

examples.en: Qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis were combined in a mixed design.
examples.cn: 定性分析与定量分析在混合设计中被结合起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「性质」加「分析」——不数多少，先读每一段在说什么，再把相似的句子连成主题：定性分析。

root: 拉丁 qualis「何种性质」→ qualitas「性质」→ 法语 qualité → 英语 quality → qualitative；希腊 analusis「拆解」← ana-「贯穿」+ luein「松开」→ 英语 analysis；社会科学把两者组合为 qualitative analysis。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the general approach to its methods and standards: non-numerical material, thematic analysis, content analysis, coding and grounded theory, case studies, the contrast with quantitative work, trustworthiness, and software-assisted coding.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从总体取径走向方法与标准：非数值材料、主题分析、内容分析、编码与扎根理论、个案研究、与定量的对照、可信度，以及软件辅助编码。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three transcripts spread on a long table, coloured notes linking similar sentences, and a theme network pinned to the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：长桌上铺开三份访谈稿，彩色便签把相似句子连起来，墙上钉着一张主题网络图。

branches.en: THE KIND OF QUESTION: non-numerical material, and the contrast with asking how much.
branches.cn: 问题的种类：非数值材料，以及与追问多少的对照。

branches.en: THE TWO LABELLING ROUTES: themes built across cases, and visible features classified and counted.
branches.cn: 两条标注路径：跨个案建立主题，以及对可见特征分类计数。

branches.en: THE UPWARD BUILD: codes and categories grown from the material itself.
branches.cn: 向上搭建：从材料本身生长出编码与类别。

branches.en: THE SINGLE CASE: mechanism shown in depth rather than frequency averaged across many.
branches.cn: 单个个案：深入展示机制，而不是在众多案例中平均频率。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC REASONING AND THE TOOL: an audit trail with peer checking, supported by software that stores but does not read.
branches.cn: 公开推理与工具：带同伴核查的审计轨迹，以及只存储不阅读的软件。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin-derived adjective for kind to a Greek-derived noun for loosening.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁来源的「性质」形容词与希腊来源的「拆解」名词组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin qualis and qualitas supply qualitative; Greek ana- and luein supply analysis; -ative and compound syntax are the English joiners.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 qualis 与 qualitas 提供「定性的」一词，希腊语 ana- 与 luein 提供「分析」，形容词词尾与复合句法是英语的连接件。

items.example: It supplies the base of quality.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 quality 的词基。

items.example: It becomes English quality.
items.exampleCN: 它成为英语 quality。

items.example: It forms qualitative.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 qualitative。

items.example: It marks the first half of the phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它标出短语的前半。

items.example: It marks taking a whole apart.
items.exampleCN: 它标出把整体拆开。

items.example: It supplies the dissolving image.
items.exampleCN: 它提供「拆解」的意象。

items.structure: Greek noun from ana- plus luein
items.example: It becomes English analysis.
items.exampleCN: 它成为英语 analysis。

items.meaning: separation of a whole into parts
items.example: The second half names the operation.
items.exampleCN: 后半命名这一操作。

items.meaning: a label attached to a segment
items.example: Coding is the basic move of the method.
items.exampleCN: 编码是这种方法的基本动作。

items.example: A theme is the pattern codes build toward.
items.exampleCN: 主题是编码向上搭成的模式。

latinEntries.structure: analysis, analysis (f., third declension, from Greek analusis)
thema, thematis (n., third declension, from Greek thema)

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 qualitas「性质」经法语而来，义为「性质；质量」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「定性的；性质上的」
由希腊语 analusis「拆解」而来，义为「分析」
由其动词形式而来，义为「分析」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「定量的」，与定性成对
